top_signals.title: Trump Opens Door to Hyperliquid as US Pulls Crypto Trade Onshore
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump said US regulators are working to bring Hyperliquid, a fast-growing crypto platform, into the country, offering one of the clearest signals yet that the White House wants to pull a major piece of the industry’s offshore market infrastructure onshore.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Mark Walter Explores Selling Stake in Chelsea FC
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Randall Williams joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Billionaire CEO of Guggenheim, Mark Walter, has explored selling his stake in Chelsea FC to Clearlake Capital, the majority owner of the London-based football club. This comes just after Walter's record-breaking sale of the Los Angeles Lakers to Josh Kushner and Bob Iger for a price of $12.5 billion.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
